record.question: Which country is known as Land of Midnight Sun?
record.explanation: Answer D: Norway. Norway is commonly called the Land of the Midnight Sun because parts of the country experience the midnight sun in summer. Reference: https://www.visitnorway.com/plan-your-trip/seasons-climate/midnight-sun/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
